steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We weren't imagining it!

options: Heaven and earth reversed in the blink of an eye.
Strange, I don't seem to feel any discomfort.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Do not be distracted by any changes in the rules of the Assimilated Universe.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Mortals were never made to set foot in this place. There is no point in trying to judge the line between the real and unreal based on our conceptions.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Look up at the sky.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The golden ocean that Rhodes Island sailed... it's hanging above our heads?!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit, I see Rhodes Island... and the churning tides.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The myriad souls call to me. They're trying to pour down and drown me—

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Logos is still fighting the myriad souls...

steps.name: W
steps.text: I don't care how above and below change. Tell me...

steps.name: W
steps.text: Where's Her Highness? Doesn't seem like she's here at all.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Damn, this place makes me feel comfortable — that disturbing kind—

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But the voice that called to me...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: That was Theresa's voice.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...The myriad souls.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: She's here. We have already found her.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Enough riddles, hag!

steps.name: W
steps.text: Look with your own eyes. Other than those weird pillars, do you see any—
She stops mid-sentence.
Pillar. Tower. Myriad souls. Theresa.
In that instant, she understands why her soul finds this place so comforting.
The myriad souls have taken crimson roots here, extending to the furthest reaches of heaven.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Those white pillars...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: They're Theresa's will. She's trying to stabilize the tower.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: She's been watching us.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Time does not flow in the Assimilated Universe, but this miracle continues to grow.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It's even trying to penetrate the 'sky' that we're standing on.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: If she could break through the limits here, that means—

steps.name: W
steps.text: Why are you looking at me like that?

steps.name: W
steps.text: I had to make sure this thing we're standing on is solid enough, right?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Don't want to get it pulled out from beneath my feet when we finally get to see Her Highness.

steps.name: W
steps.text: But this 'sky' is more than what it looks.

steps.name: W
steps.text: My bombs didn't even leave a mark...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It's impossible to damage this place by any physical means.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The 'limits' of this place are set by rules beyond the comprehension of Terra and incredible amounts of information.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It permits neither change nor challenge.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Could've fooled me.

steps.name: W
steps.text: You're hiding something. Hood was right. This tower has broken through whatever 'limits' you're talking about.

steps.name: W
steps.text: I know you have secrets that not even Hood and Bunny know about.

steps.name: W
steps.text: You've never been here, but you're strangely familiar with many things here.

steps.name: W
steps.text: You hide it well on your face, but you can't fool me.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: W, don't—

steps.name: W
steps.text: We can't afford to waste any more time.

steps.name: W
steps.text: If Her Highness has fallen asleep while waiting for us, someone has to put new batteries in the alarm clock.

options: She's not as reckless as she looks, Kal'tsit.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Hah.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Give me a hand, bunny. There's something I need to make sure...

steps.name: W
steps.text: I was wondering. Why would there be shadows in this hellhole, when there's no sun and no moon?
She throws her flashbang upwards. Rather than fall back to the ground, it keeps going up.
The ball of light rises from the 'sky', flying towards the golden ocean, revealing a blurry shadow.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Over there, Amiya! That shadow that won't go away!

steps.name: W
steps.text: He's here too...

options: He might attack again! Careful, Amiya!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I don't sense any hostility. It's like...

steps.name: W
steps.text: He doesn't even notice us.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Wanna do it, bunny? I've got a score to settle with him.

steps.name: W
steps.text: He must know something about this godforsaken place!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Wait, W!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: This is strange... he's not like the other myriad souls we've seen, lingering here rather than leaving...

steps.name: W
steps.text: If he's here, does it mean he's dead too?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No. He's fine... in fact, he's never been better.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: He's fully at peace. I can feel it. A peace filled with sorrow.

steps.name: W
steps.text: What did Her Highness do to him?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Theresa saved him, retaining the last bit of consciousness that the revenant had left.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Not only that, she has brought clarity to his chaotic mind.

steps.name: W
steps.text: She cured his madness? She can do that now?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I don't know what Theresa's state is right now.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Can you communicate with the revenant, Amiya?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: He may hold the key to the truth.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I can try...
A dark wave ripples from Amiya, touching the black shadow.
The shadow meanders and answers the King's whisper.

steps.name: Revenant's Shadow
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Revenant's Shadow
steps.text: So, it is you who arrived here after all, in the end.
The indistinct shadow opens its 'mouth'. His tone is surprisingly calm, with no hint of anger.
An instant of clarity had arrived after millennia of torment, soothing his fury at long last.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It is no coincidence that you are here, Revenant.

steps.name: Revenant's Shadow
steps.text: Theresa saved me, preserving the fragment of soul that should have disappeared.

steps.name: Revenant's Shadow
steps.text: I merely followed her to this place... to witness the turning point of Sarkaz destiny.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Where did you say Theresa... Her Highness is?

steps.name: Revenant's Shadow
steps.text: She has departed to retrieve the seed from the very beginning.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The seed... Amnannam?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Isn't Amnannam already under Sarkaz control? What else is Theresa trying to do?

steps.name: Revenant's Shadow
steps.text: Originium created everything in this land.

steps.name: Revenant's Shadow
steps.text: It has been utilized in many ways, but no one has truly mastered it.

steps.name: Revenant's Shadow
steps.text: Except.. Her Highness.

steps.name: Revenant's Shadow
steps.text: She said she would steal the fire from the source of all suffering. Our curse will become the weapon that reshapes our lives.

steps.name: Revenant's Shadow
steps.text: An immaculate garden for the Sarkaz...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: After all we've been through, I think you know what this means, Doctor.

options: Theresa is fighting for authority over Originium itself.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The vision of Theresa and Theresis goes beyond the limits of all knowledge on Terra.

options: I can't let Originium become a weapon of mass destruction.

steps.text: There are no more questions. Kal'tsit gazes at you silently. You have been through too much together.

steps.name: W
steps.text: So you can talk normally, after all, not just all that crap about suffering.

steps.name: Revenant's Shadow
steps.text: I was human, once.

steps.name: W
steps.text: ...Hmph.

steps.name: Revenant's Shadow
steps.text: I had raged against many things in my long existence.

steps.name: Revenant's Shadow
steps.text: The invasion of the Ancients, the betrayal of the Sankta, the fall of Kazdel... and my rejection by the myriad souls.

steps.name: Revenant's Shadow
steps.text: Until I came here, and learned the true nature of the myriad souls.

steps.name: Revenant's Shadow
steps.text: All I feel now is sorrow.

steps.name: W
steps.text: And you've stopped making sense again.

steps.name: Revenant's Shadow
steps.text: Did you not see the myriad souls on the golden ocean?

steps.name: Revenant's Shadow
steps.text: All Sarkaz struggle against the injustice of fate their entire lives. There is no release, even in death.

steps.name: Revenant's Shadow
steps.text: The myriad souls are only broken fragments of information that linger in this space, imprisoned in another manner by another will...

steps.name: Revenant's Shadow
steps.text: But Her Highness said she would purge purgatory and bring salvation to all Sarkaz...

steps.name: W
steps.text: You seem to be able to communicate with this old guy, Kal'tsit. Why don't you translate what he's saying?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Is Theresa already able to modify the information within Originium?

steps.name: Revenant's Shadow
steps.text: This was her promise. Theresa keeps her promises...

steps.name: Revenant's Shadow
steps.text: Ah, finally... Theresa.

steps.name: W
steps.text: What did you say? Where is she?

options: Amiya, the shadow under your feet!

steps.text: Shadow?
How could I cast a shadow when there is no light?
No, this is not my shadow!
Amiya looks down and sees the striding white silhouette through the 'sky' that she is standing on.
'Sky' and 'Beyond Sky'.
Theresa and Amiya, reflections of each other.
'Amiya...'
Amiya hears a whisper. She looks up, and Theresa is standing by her side.
She takes Amiya's hand.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Damn. The battlefield... it's changing again!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Vina, the ground... it's rumbling.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Stay at your post, Hannah! Don't get distracted!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: That thing above the Shard just released some strange form of energy.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: If the Sighs of Kings fails—

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Remain alert! Allied command is reporting at least seven coordinates where sudden changes in terrain have occurred!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Three assault ships belonging to the Duke of Abercorn reported destroyed. Communications were lost with two force recon units under the Duke of Ashworth—

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Order all units to stop attacking Hill C-9.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Scatter to the sides, or we'll be swallowed by the waves of Originium.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Got it! Everyone's moving!

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: And we've got another really bad news.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Looks like someone's sitting on that empty throne in the Nachzehrer camp...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: The Nachzehrer King is back...

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: The fog... it's getting thicker. The Sarkaz are striking back!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Horn, you and Bagpipe coordinate operations with allied command.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: You're more familiar with the army's commands. The other units will support us.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Lose this pass, and we'll lose all the ground that we took.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Roger!

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: I'll help. I'm gettin' used to dealin' with this stuff.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Captain, look... the Gloriana. It's crystalizing quickly. The Sarkaz are besieging it!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: The Duke of Caster is still on the ship.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Victoria can't afford to lose another duke in battle.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: We—
The sound of electrical static, then the same voice is heard over all communications channels on the Victorian side.

steps.name: Static-Filled Radio
steps.text: Attention all soldiers of the alliance. This is the Duke of Caster, in command of the Gloriana.

steps.name: Static-Filled Radio
steps.text: You see as I do how the Sarkaz tyrant has torn our motherland apart.

steps.name: Static-Filled Radio
steps.text: The malice and barbarism of our foe merely serves to strengthen our resolve to defend our country.

steps.name: Static-Filled Radio
steps.text: As long as our ships and soldiers... *Bzzt*... as long as we all do our duty...

steps.name: Static-Filled Radio
steps.text: This is the resolve of Parliament—and every citizen, duke or commoner, general or soldier... *Bzzt*...

steps.name: Static-Filled Radio
steps.text: Our foe climbs the broken bow of the Gloriana once more. Originium threatens to devour our fortress.

steps.name: Static-Filled Radio
steps.text: But you have not yielded, brave soldiers! Neither will Caster!

steps.name: Static-Filled Radio
steps.text: ...*Bzzt* I shall step up to the frontlines and stand with you... *Bzzt* ...

steps.name: Static-Filled Radio
steps.text: We stand upon Mother Victoria—

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: The Duke of Caster...

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Is... is he mad?!

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: The steam knight went mad a long time ago, Hannah.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Did I see that right? Did the steam knight just smash into the Gloriana?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: No, he smashed into the almost-crystalized Stone of the Sword and Sighs of Kings...

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: What is he trying to do?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: ...He wants to save his Victoria.
Even the frightened soldiers in the rear heard the unusual sound from the Gloriana.
The armor patrols the Stone of the Sword, trampling every Sarkaz who attempts to approach it.
But he could contain the spread of Originium.
'Victoria!!'
He roars, he smashes the ground, but there is nothing he could do to stop the Originium from swallowing the Realmblade—
And so he charged at its foe, towards the Gloriana devoured by Originium.
Originium crystals shatter. The shock sends the Sighs of Kings flying, landing at Vina's feet, before countless eyes wide with astonishment.
Vina pulls out the sword that had been with her for so long.
She points it at the charging foe and spreading fog, not one step back.
She is answered by the call to charge and the sound of blasting steam.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: You've grown.
Her tone is as gentle and mild as Amiya remembers.
But Amiya knows that it is not the same Theresa as the one who had once held her in her arms and told her stories all night.
Amiya had so many questions that she had hoped to find the answer for when they met.
But she could not say anything, ask anything.
Theresa would not permit it.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Shh. I can hear the questions within you, Amiya.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: But I can't answer them. All answers, all explanations are pale and powerless.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Our reunion was the product of an accident.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Perhaps I was looking forward to this moment too.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: You, Kal'tsit, W... and Doctor. You stand before me.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: I'm sincerely joyful for this reunion. You feel it, don't you?
Why?
She should have been sure. She should not hesitate—
The one before her could not possibly be Theresa.
Why, then, does she look exactly the same as Theresa, not just in her appearance, but also in her expression, her eyes, and the emotions?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You... you're not...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You're not... Theresa...

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Do you truly think that, Amiya?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The Theresa I know would never do something like this...

steps.name: W
steps.text: Enough, Your Highness.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Damn... I came here thinking I had it thought through, but I couldn't find any words other than 'Your Highness' before that face.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: I remember you...

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: W.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Hah. You remember me. There's no greater honor I've won in my entire career as a merc.

steps.name: W
steps.text: I would have ran up to hug you, if circumstances were any different.

steps.name: W
steps.text: But you don't know, and you don't need to know, how many times I've said goodbye to you already.

steps.name: W
steps.text: This might sound sentimental, but... you were special to me like no one ever was. You showed a wandering mercenary sights that she never thought she would see.

steps.name: W
steps.text: So, the only way I can repay you is by putting you to rest.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Is that so...?

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: You still call me 'Your Highness'. You still remember that I'm the King of Sarkaz.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Then the only thing for me to do is to protect the Sarkaz.
What did Theresa just do?!
Amiya turns around to see that everything has changed.
The white pillar has grown at a breathtaking rate. The immeasurable 'tower' of infinity now 'falls' at breakneck pace.
Only the place the she stands upon...
Only around Theresa is there eternal peace and silence.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: This tower is beautiful, Amiya.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: It will continue to grow forever, breaking through all limits, and hold up the heavens for the garden that will rewrite Sarkaz destiny.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: How I wanted you to see it...

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: But you are not permitted here. Accidents must be eliminated.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: When you stand before me...

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: You're the enemy of the Sarkaz.
No.
A black crown appears above Amiya's head.
'I won't allow that, Theresa!'
